svg.title: Two-Sided Volume Sandwich and Main-Term Cancellation in New.star_inequality
svg.desc: Editorial mathematical diagram of New.star_inequality (src/New/Reduction/MainInequality.lean) in three horizontal bands. Band 1 shows the sandwiched quantity (V + 2 delta) / d_T (covolume plus twice the twist-independent index per target dimension for n linearly independent short integral forms y_1, ..., y_n with (1 - 4/b^2) d_T <= n <= d_T) trapped between the Lower Floor from Theorem C (D.integral_forms_long, Stages 05-07 input: mainAmount - 3 loss, using TwistedLattice.covolume_add_index_nonneg and determinant height bound, per-dimension error 3 f a log^4 b) and the Upper Ceiling from Theorems A and B (ShortAndEnough.lean: mainAmount - (n/d_T) m rem + loss + 2 indexPerDim, where Theorem A(a) span_short_integralRamified_eq_top plus Hadamard contributes V <= n (mainAmount - m rem + f a log^4 b), and Theorem A(b) indexLe_normalizedPoincare plus Theorem B enough_forms with #t dim src <= 5 d_T log(1 + 2 b^2) and n >= (1 - 4/b^2) d_T >= d_T / 2 contribute 2 indexPerDim = 20 log(1 + 2 b^2) f a log^3 b). Band 2 displays matched proportional horizontal bars for the Lower Floor and Upper Ceiling where the shared mainAmount baseline cancels identically (using n <= d_T and mainAmount >= 0), trapping the negative remainder signal -(n/d_T) m rem strictly inside the error budget err = 4 loss + 2 indexPerDim. Band 3 divides by n >= d_T / 2 to isolate New.star_inequality: m totalRemainder <= |2 err| <= f a log^5 b, feeding OneSidedBound via totalRemainder = a (#Phi_b (R_{q_0}(x) - R_{q_0}(x_1)) + #Phi_a R_1(x_1)).

g.text: V ≤ n · (mainAmount − m·rem + f a log⁴ b)
Drop middle term: compare Floor ≤ Ceiling
